discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B013 (packets 213, 420, 462, 494). 29 standard searches, snippets/summaries only (German/French translated). dein-dlrp April summary names all four black-white-red pins with per-pin prices: new Minnie heart balloon and Mickey+Minnie heart balloons (one pin). dein-dlrp October confirms six NBC pins = 4 OE + 2 LE (no unnamed OE). passiondlp My Cat PDF summary maps 2018 dates: new Dinah (6 Jan), Yzma (24 Mar), Mochi (17 Nov), held on mapping; day dates added for Rajah/Jasmine, Oliver, Jazzy, Figaro. Incredibles PTN (29 Jun 2018) set lead only. Holds retained: Fun Adventures, Ursula BTM, Bambi Flower, Pirates & Princesses, PTN trios, Marvel poster/trio, Tod, Cherry Blossom, RVG designs.
